milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The yellow concrete powder blocks are on the floor at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4). max_distance=3 ensures the player must walk forward from spawn (which is 4 blocks away at Z=0) to actually approach the blocks, preventing immediate satisfaction. facing_tolerance=60 confirms the player is looking down at the bright yellow blocks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The heavy weighted pressure plate is at spawn-relative (0, 0, 6) on the smooth stone corridor floor. max_distance=4 ensures the player has entered the corridor (past the dividing wall at Z=2) and is close enough to observe the thin plate on the floor. From spawn at Z=0, distance to target is 6 > 4, so the player must walk forward. facing_tolerance=60 confirms they are looking toward the pressure plate.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The brown bed is at spawn-relative (1, 0, 10)-(1, 0, 11) in the back room behind the corridor. max_distance=5 ensures the player has navigated through the entire corridor, passed the back doorway at Z=9, and is near the bed. From spawn, distance to target is ~10 > 5, requiring significant navigation. facing_tolerance=60 confirms visual observation of the bed.
